steps.note: Open the single-stage RFQ setup screen.

args.label: How will you award the event?
options: I'll award the entire lot to single Vendor
I may partially award the event to multiple

steps.note: Verify the RFQ awarding choices offered by the configuration.
Select RFQ with awarding of the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Add two products so whole-lot allocation is distinguishable from line-item allocation.
Commit the event schedule before publishing.
Invite one vendor to receive and answer the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit an RFQ quote.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so awarding is available.
Open the comparison grid containing the submitted RFQ bid.
Enter the awarding flow to inspect lot allocation.
Allocate the RFQ award to the single available vendor.
Verify that all line items are awarded to exactly one vendor, demonstrating whole-lot awarding.
